top_signal.title: How do you develop a brand?
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone!   How do you go about building a brand? I help people prepare for programming exams and generally support them in their programming development.   In the future, I’d like to expand into exam preparation (like the EGE/OGE in Russia) for various subjects, along with a whole range of other things.   However, I’m not entirely sure how to manage this properly—how to grow a social media presence, how to find clients, and so on.   Could you offer some advice or recommend any books that might help clarify things?   Thanks!       submitted by     /u/Radiant-Strength-448       [link]       [comments]
